[Verse - vocal starts at 0:00, no intro]
"Grandpa skipped a page!" she laughed.
The words were just a blur.
My son came with a lamp.
"It's bright. That's the point."
[Chorus]
Now I read every word.
"Read it again!" she begs.
Try Acme for thirty nights.
[Short instrumental ending]
